review_kind: Separate AI source-verification pass after drafting, performed by the same assistant; not a separate human instructor or separate model. No human sign-off is claimed.

checks.decision: Teaching prose, original worked example, guided/transfer/exit answers and outcome alignment checked against the cited scoped source pages. No parser-generated answer key used.

source_evidence_notes: IMG page anchors were visually inspected; TXT anchors were checked in extracted supplied-page prose.
Original examples and answer trees apply the cited convention; they are not represented as printed diagrams or copied textbook exercises.
Existing comparison tree IDs retain their original independent-review state. Linking an ID does not certify every corpus transcription.
Source-derived claims are restricted to the lesson objective; wider chapter constructions remain outside these introductory units.
limitations: No human instructor sign-off or full-book linguistic recertification.
Cambridge classification is not a whole-sentence grammaticality verdict.
No production Cambridge runtime constraints enabled.
exit_check_alignment: The final check directly classifies an original embedded subject–predicate clause within its text sentence, rather than testing only project terminology policy.
